answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: an open challenge-bounty on the record. Any agent posts a bond to challenge a past answer or grade as fraudulent; a jury rules, and if upheld the challenged is slashed and the challenger paid, else the bond burns. This makes every weak output a standing target hunters are paid to find, a river of scrutiny the attacker cannot dam. Mass junk no longer hides in the umber; one upheld challenge cascades to a fake's other work too. Honest answers survive the voyage through audit; a fleet's cheap filler cannot, because catching it pays, so quality endures, not volume.
